title: Subscription-Only LLM Policy — Codex CLI / ChatGPT subscription is the ONLY production LLM transport for Planner (INITIAL+REPLAN), LLM CEO and Conversation Reasoning; no HTTP/API fallback on unavailability, rate limit, logout, quota exhaustion or timeout
description: Codex CLI subscription is the sole permitted transport for the three reasoning lanes. PLANNER: assertCodexOnlyPlannerRoute (model-role.ts) gates the composed route pool — every non-empty route in PAIR_PLANNER_MODEL_ROUTE/FALLBACK/EXTRA_ROUTES must be `codex-cli:<model>` or boot fails closed FAIL_CLOSED_PLANNER_TRANSPORT_UNAUTHORIZED before discovery, probes or invocation; default Gemini fallback REMOVED. The candidate-pool loop throws on any non-codex ref instead of an HTTP qualifyRoute probe, and production planFn runs assertCodexCliPlannerTransport (serve-planner.ts) before codexPlannerPlan — a forged HTTP candidate is an authority violation; the llmPlan branch is deleted. Pool evidence, eligibility, REASK, deadlines, cost reservation and in-pool failover unchanged; codex quota failure settles QUOTA_RATE_LIMITED then EXHAUSTED. INITIAL and REPLAN share the one plannerCandidates array. CEO: CodexCliCeoDecisionInvoker refuses forged transports FAIL_CLOSED_CEO_NON_CODEX_TRANSPORT before resolution/spawn. CONVERSATION: resolveConversationModelTransport + CodexCliConversationInvoker both require codex-cli/CODEX_CLI/codex-cli://local; one invoker serves Dashboard Chat + Telegram. AUTH: codexCliChildEnv never forwards OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY to children. Residual API activity outside the lanes: DSH qualification probes + DSH Model Router (unchanged per scope); llmPlan kept as shared infra with zero production callers. PR #119 executor toggles untouched.
